bio: Daniela and Domenico Allegretta opened this charming little restaurant with a family feel here in the Old Town. She is in charge of the friendly and attentive service and also presents the regional wines; he takes care of the cooking. His creative Mediterranean cuisine with international influences includes exciting combinations, for example, "Skrei, red lentils, purple curry, dates, pak choi" or "Pork cheek and thick flank (from an organic farm, Biohof May), spelt, broccoli, mustard, lychee". There is also the option of picking dishes from the small à la carte menu to put together a three- or four-course set menu. Lunchtime revolves around a simpler daily menu.
